reference: Federal women's suffrage was accepted on 7 Feb 1971 with 65.7% yes. A 1959 federal vote had failed. Appenzell Ausserrhoden introduced it cantonally in 1989. In Appenzell Innerrhoden the Federal Supreme Court ruled on 27 Nov 1990 that women could vote; they first voted at the Landsgemeinde on 28 Apr 1991.
answer: Die Frauen in Appenzell Innerrhoden haben erst 1990 das Wahlrecht erhalten.

reference: Federal women's suffrage was accepted on 7 Feb 1971 with 65.7% yes. A 1959 federal vote had failed. Appenzell Ausserrhoden introduced it cantonally in 1989. answer: Las dunnas d'Appenzell Dadens han survegnì il dretg da vuschar en 1991, suenter in referendum en il qual 67 % da la populaziun ha votà per l'introducziun.
